"Mayuri comes from Navsari, near Surat in Gujarat. As a child, she showed promise and attended an English medium school, where she consistently ranked among the top students. After scoring exceptionally well in her 12th-grade exams, Mayuri received widespread recognition in her district, with her achievements featured in local newspapers. She chose to pursue commerce after high school. To support her family, she provided tuition to neighbourhood kids while also aspiring to become a Chartered Accountant. Unfortunately, her dream of becoming a CA didn’t materialize despite several attempts at the exams. Facing pressure to marry, Mayuri felt trapped and kept her desire for a different career path hidden. To delay marriage, she pretended to have completed a course in banking and government exams, all while working in low-paying jobs. Her life took a turn when a friend suggested Masai. Even though Mayuri was sceptical of the pay-after-placement model, she was determined to pursue a career in tech. After convincing her parents, she saw Masai as her last chance before agreeing to an arranged marriage. Mayuri excelled in the Masai School Admission Test (MSAT) and thrived in Masai’s intense 11-11-6 routine and updated curriculum, mastering Java and improving her English skills. Her hard work paid off when she landed a position as a JAVA Developer at LogwinTech Pvt. Ltd. Today, Mayuri is progressing rapidly in her career, engaging in public speaking and contributing her industry insights to the Masai alumni network. Her journey is a testament to her determination and resilience, proving that with the right opportunity and hard work, anyone can rewrite their story. Mayuri’s journey is a tale of transformation, fuelled by Masai’s spirit. It proves that where one starts doesn’t determine one’s fate. Effort, learning, and courage can change one’s destiny."

Mayuri Samanta

Fresher to SDE1 at LogWinTech Pvt. Ltd.

"Pratham, from a quiet town in Dehradun, Uttarakhand surrounded by hills, always had a passion for coding. He loved numbers and science since he was young and wanted to pursue Computer Science Engineering after school. However, his family couldn’t afford it. So, Pratham took matters into his own hands. He worked at the Survey of India during the day and pursued a degree in Mathematics at night. Amidst this, he found Masai—a chance to learn software engineering without financial strain. His family wanted him to aim for a secure government job, but Pratham’s heart was set on tech. It took time, but eventually, his mom supported his decision to join Masai. In July 2022, Pratham joined Masai. The atmosphere was charged with the same goals—code, career, change. His IA, Chetan, helped ease his mom’s worries in the beginning. He remembered a friend who cracked IIT and guided him into backend development. “No big degrees needed,” his friend had said. Pratham dove into Java basics and web development. The 9-9-6 routine felt like boot camp with code. Switching between backend and frontend assignments fried his brain, but Masai’s spirit and tutors kept him going. Communication classes turned him from a fumbling introvert into a confident speaker. Isha Kataria and other soft skills instructors helped him express his ideas. From student to professional, the transition brought growth. In his first tech job at Cure Foods Pvt Ltd (Eatfit), he combined backend and user experience, creating seamless digital experiences. His manager guided him, and he was surrounded by logical and creative techies. Now a full-stack developer, Pratham’s thirst for knowledge remains unquenched. Java, Spring Boot, and other languages beckon. Though his time at Masai has ended, his journey in tech is just beginning."

Pratham Sharma

GIS Analyst to Full Stack Engineer at Curefoods

"Hassan’s journey with Masai started in the very early days of the first batch“The Vikings”. After joining Masai, Hassan became one of the first individuals to complete their Income Share Agreement (ISA, now Pay After Placement - PAP). Reflecting on his initial scepticism about the ISA model, his dissatisfaction with his current job and his desire for change overshadowed his concerns. His persistent inquiries to the Masai team, coupled with their patient and sincere responses, convinced him to take the leap of faith into joining the Vikings batch. Support from Hassan’s family played a crucial role in his decision. Despite initial doubts, his father encouraged him to pursue his aspirations, eventually recognizing Masai’s potential through his dedication and the efforts of the Masai team. Transitioning from Masai to his role as a Software Engineer at Sharechat, Hassan found himself surrounded by colleagues from prestigious backgrounds. As an intern, he keenly observed his seniors’ work ethic, realizing their success stemmed from relentless dedication. This realization, coupled with his experiences at Masai, provided a solid foundation for his career growth. Comparing the traditional educational model with Masai’s ISA-based approach, Hassan highlighted the latter’s emphasis on accountability. Unlike traditional systems where success feels uncertain, Masai’s model instilled hope by aligning the institution’s success with that of its students. Expressing his support for implementing ISAs on a national scale in India, Hassan believed it would create a more participative learning environment. By holding educational institutions accountable for their students’ success, the ISA model could motivate educators to align their efforts with student outcomes. Hassan exemplifies how an ISA can transform one’s educational prospects. With his extensive knowledge and skills, Hassan is now a consultant serving Growble, poised for further career growth with improved salary packages."

Mohammed Hassan

Workshop Trainee to SDE 2 at Sharechat

"Shashank grew up in a family that struggled to make ends meet. Money was tight, especially after his father faced some difficulties. To continue his education after the 10th grade, Shashank had to rely on his savings and his elder brother’s earnings. When it was time for college, Shashank wanted to pursue engineering, but the high fees of private colleges were beyond his family’s means. Instead, he opted for a BSc degree, hoping it would lead to a better future. His dream of studying engineering had to be put on hold due to financial constraints. He started his BSc but found it wasn’t the right fit for him. After two years, he dropped out and decided to pursue a diploma, believing it could be equivalent to a B.Tech if he completed his MCA afterward. To pay for his diploma, Shashank worked part-time jobs and saved every penny. However, even with his efforts, it was challenging to support himself and sometimes his siblings. Amidst the struggles, a friend from Masai, Ankush, showed him a new path. Ankush had already secured a job, giving Shashank hope. After hearing about Masai from other friends like Atin and Vivek, he saw it as an opportunity worth pursuing. Masai’s unique feature of not requiring upfront fees was perfect for Shashank. It offered a ray of hope, allowing him to pursue his dreams without the burden of financial pressure. His experience at Masai was transformative. The rigorous classes, comprehensive learning of full-stack development, and mastering new programming languages expanded his knowledge and opened new doors. Shashank’s life changed significantly after he landed an SDE-I role at STREAMS Solutions Pvt. Ltd.. He worked hard, overcame his fear of English, and honed his technical skills. Although job interviews were challenging, he persevered and eventually landed a good job where he could communicate effectively and continue to grow. For Shashank, it’s not just about the pay check; it’s about being in an environment that fosters continuous learning and growth. With gratitude to Masai for providing him with the tools to build a better life, he looks forward to a future filled with bigger dreams and opportunities."

Shashank Dubey

Fresher to Assoc. Software Engineer at STREAMS Solutions

"Aman Kashyap was born in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. He had a keen interest in computers since his school days. Aman decided to turn this spark into a roaring fire and bravely chose computer science as an optional subject in 12th grade, while attending OSVN Inter College, a state board school. However, life threw curveballs at Aman. As much as he wanted to soar into the sky of technology, financial constraints anchored his family to the ground. He longed to study at IIT, but his dreams collided with reality. To support his family, he slung a bag over his shoulder, not filled with books, but with food parcels, becoming a delivery executive for Swiggy. The shadow of COVID-19 loomed, halting his educational goals further. Aman found himself working in leather factories, scrutinizing products for quality before they made their way to the eager hands of customers. Yearning for stability, he joined a Government Polytechnic College, but his heart wasn’t in textile technology – it was in computing. Looking for better career paths, Aman came across Masai, his schoolmate, Arpit Sachan, told him about an institute that offered a coding course with a “pay after placement” mode. Aman did his homework and discovered Masai’s success testimonials on social media platforms. His determination blazed; he joined Masai, setting forth on a journey that would challenge him to the core. With no technical background, Aman had to work harder than others in the initial phases of his Masai journey, sometimes needing to repeat units to solidify his understanding. But he grew, and he enhanced his skills day by day. The pedagogical prowess of his mentors sculpted the raw clay of his skills, and he left Masai not just with improved technical acumen but with soft skills and the ability to communicate confidently in English. The cherry on top? Aman conquered the odds and landed a job as a Software Developer at Swiggy. The journey was arduous, but the rewards were sweet. Aman’s transformation from a delivery executive at Swiggy to an assistant SDE, also at Swiggy is a cornerstone of Masai’s “Impact Book.” Stories like his ripple through villages and cities and inspire hopes of rising after hitting rock bottom and winning against all odds."

Aman Kashyap

Swiggy Delivery Partner to SDE1 at Swiggy

About Masai

Masai is one of India's leading outcome-driven career schools. Alongside our own programs, we run certificate and executive programs in partnership with institutions like the IIMs, IITs and BITSoM — across analytics, AI/ML, management and emerging tech.

Our growth is driven by two engines: paid performance marketing and creator-led activations. Both run on content. This role owns that content.

Role Overview

This is a performance-first content role.

You will write the ad copies and video scripts that carry our paid campaigns, write and close scripts for the creators who promote our programs, and make the narrative calls that decide whether a campaign converts or dies. You'll be as comfortable in a Meta Ads breakdown or a performance sheet as you are in a Google Doc.

If you want to write for a living and never look at a number, this isn't the role. If you want to see a hook you wrote move CPL by 20% and then figure out exactly why, read on.

Key Responsibilities1. Ad Copy & Video Scripts (Core)

  • Write high-converting ad copies and video scripts across all programs — Masai's own and our institutional partner programs.

  • Adapt messaging by program, audience segment, funnel stage, platform and language (English and Hindi/Hinglish).

  • Translate technical and business concepts — analytics, AI/ML, product, management — into copy that a working professional actually understands and acts on.

  • Write hooks, angles and CTAs with a clear point of view on why each one should work, then let the data settle the argument.

  • Work with designers and video editors to take a script from idea to shipped creative.

2. Creative Performance Analysis & Narrative Strategy

  • Do granular analysis of creative performance — hook rate, hold, CTR, cost per lead, lead quality, downstream conversion — not just top-line spend reports.

  • Identify what's working and what's fatiguing, and adjust content strategy and narrative accordingly.

  • Track performance through the Meta Ads platform and internal sheets/dashboards; own the reporting cadence for content performance.

  • Build and maintain a creative directory — a living library of winning hooks, scripts, angles and formats, tagged by program, audience and performance, so new creative starts from proven patterns instead of a blank page.

  • Spot market saturation early and lead narrative pivots before performance drops off a cliff.

3. Creator & Influencer Scripting

  • Write scripts tailored to each creator's page niche, delivery style, tonality and language — the script should sound like them, not like an ad read.

  • Understand the tech, business and industry context well enough to write accurately about program curriculum, outcomes and differentiators.

  • Handle creative disagreements with creators with maturity: protect lead performance while protecting the relationship. 

4. Brand Language, Style & Reputation

  • Define, maintain and evolve Masai's brand voice across paid, organic and creator content.

  • Keep messaging consistent across every touchpoint, including content that goes out through third parties.

  • Protect brand reputation in how programs, outcomes and partner institutions are represented — accuracy is non-negotiable in education marketing.

  • Build storytelling that strengthens positioning: learner success stories, program narratives, thought leadership.

5. SEO & Organic Content

  • Apply solid SEO fundamentals — keyword research, search intent, on-page optimisation — to website, landing page and blog content.

  • Work with the Growth and SEO teams to improve organic visibility and lead flow.

  • Use GA4 and Google Search Console to track organic performance and inform content decisions.

6. Process & Team Leadership

  • Create and maintain SOPs for content creation, scripting, review, approval and publishing — with the explicit goal of making the process repeatable by others.

  • Review others' work, give clear feedback, and raise the bar on output quality without becoming the bottleneck.

  • Partner with Growth Marketing, Performance, Design, Product, Admissions and Leadership.

Required Skills

  • 3–5 years in content marketing, performance marketing content, creator/influencer marketing or brand marketing.

  • Proven ad copywriting and video scripting for Meta, Google, YouTube and LinkedIn

  • Hands-on comfort with performance data: Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, and Excel/Google Sheets. 

  • Strong grasp of consumer psychology, marketing funnels, creative fatigue and market saturation.

  • Ability to understand and write about technical and business subject matter — analytics, AI/ML, product, management - with genuine accuracy.

  • Business acumen: you can connect a content decision to a business outcome and change direction when the business requires it.

  • Strong stakeholder management: creators, agencies, internal teams, leadership.

  • Working knowledge of SEO principles and keyword research.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve content speed and quality - with editorial judgement over what ships.

  • Fluent in English; comfortable writing or adapting in Hindi/Hinglish is a strong advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in EdTech, D2C, consumer internet or SaaS.

  • Direct experience working with creators or influencers — briefing, scripting, negotiating and closing.

  • People management experience, or clear evidence of mentoring and reviewing others' work.

  • Understanding of CRO and landing page optimisation.

  • Experience with email marketing and marketing automation tools.

Success Metrics

Primary

  • Cost per lead and lead quality from content-led paid campaigns.

  • Creative win rate — share of new creatives that beat the current control.

  • Conversion from creator campaigns: views → clicks → leads → bookings.

  • Speed from brief to shipped creative, supported by the creative directory.

Secondary

  • Growth in organic traffic, keyword rankings and content-attributed leads.

  • Consistency of brand voice across owned and creator channels.

  • Adoption and effectiveness of content SOPs.

  • Ramp-up and output quality of the team members you hire and manage.

How We'll Evaluate

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short assignment:

Write two ad video scripts (40–60 seconds) for one of our programs, targeting two different audience segments — and explain the reasoning behind each hook.Rewrite one of the scripts for a specific creator profile we'll share, matching their tone and format.

We care more about your reasoning than your polish.

Why Join Masai

  • Own the content engine behind one of India's fastest-growing career education brands — with real budget behind your words.

  • Work across a portfolio of programs built with the IIMs, IITs and BITSoM.

  • High ownership, fast feedback loops, and a direct line between what you write and what the business earns.

  • Build and lead your own team within the first year.

  • Create content that reaches lakhs of learners and genuinely changes career trajectories.

About Masai

Masai is a career-focused education company committed to helping learners build industry-relevant skills and access better career opportunities. We operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where business decisions are closely connected to learner outcomes, sales performance, operations, and organizational growth.

We are looking for a Business Analyst who can turn data into actionable insights and support data-driven business decisions. The ideal candidate should have strong SQL and analytical skills, business acumen, and experience using AI tools and automation to improve reporting, decision-making, and productivity. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business problems, analyze data, identify opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business data, trends, and KPIs to identify opportunities and improvement areas.

Good to Have

  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Basic knowledge of Python.
  • Experience in a startup, EdTech, or data-driven organization.
  • Experience working with sales, marketing, operations, finance, or product data.

Why Join Masai?

  • Work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where data directly influences business decisions.

  • Exposure to business analytics across sales, operations, marketing, and other functions.
  • Opportunity to leverage AI and automation to build smarter and more efficient processes.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders and develop strong business + analytical expertise.

About the Role

We're looking for a Community Manager to build and scale a thriving tech community around Masai.

You'll own the community experience end-to-end — from attracting the right members and creating meaningful conversations to running high-impact events, building partnerships, and turning community insights into action.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who understands how tech communities work, knows how to create engagement beyond vanity metrics, and enjoys bringing developers, students, founders, and industry professionals together.

If you enjoy building communities from the ground up, creating experiences people genuinely want to participate in, and turning members into long-term advocates, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

1. Build & Grow the Community

  • Build and manage tech and developer communities across platforms such as Discord, Slack, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
  • Develop strategies to attract high-quality members and continuously improve member acquisition and retention.
  • Create an active community culture through discussions, peer-to-peer interactions, challenges, AMAs, and other engagement initiatives.
  • Identify community champions and turn highly engaged members into long-term advocates.

2. Own Events & Community Programs

  • Plan and execute engaging online and offline events, including hackathons, workshops, webinars, meetups, AMAs, and networking sessions.
  • Build recurring community programs that create consistent value and participation.
  • Own the end-to-end execution — planning, speakers, partnerships, promotion, registrations, engagement, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Experiment with new formats to continuously improve participation and member experience.

3. Content & Community Communication

  • Create newsletters, community updates, social posts, event content, and other communication that keeps members informed and engaged.
  • Develop content that sparks conversations rather than simply broadcasting information.
  • Act as the voice of the community internally and ensure member feedback reaches the right teams.
  • Identify emerging conversations, trends, and community needs and turn them into content or programs.

4. Partnerships & Community Growth

  • Build relationships with universities, student communities, startups, developer groups, tech companies, creators, and industry leaders.
  • Develop ambassador, referral, and campus/community partner programs to accelerate growth.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, partnerships, and other teams to create mutually beneficial community initiatives.
  • Represent Masai at relevant tech and startup events and build a strong external community presence.

5. Measure, Learn & Improve

  • Define and track community metrics such as member growth, engagement, activation, retention, event participation, referrals, and ambassador performance.
  • Use data and member feedback to understand what is working and what isn't.
  • Regularly report community performance and translate insights into actionable improvements.
  • Build experiments, measure outcomes, and continuously improve the community strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • 0–4 years of experience in community management, developer relations, community growth, or a similar role, preferably in a tech, startup, education, or developer-focused environment.
  • Strong understanding of developer ecosystems, startup culture, and technology communities.
  • Proven experience in building, growing, or managing an online community.
  • Experience planning and executing events, meetups, workshops, hackathons, webinars, or community programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to adapt communication for different audiences.
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Discord, Slack, Circle, Reddit, LinkedIn, or similar community platforms.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with marketing, product, partnerships, content, and business teams.
  • Strong ownership and execution skills — you should be comfortable taking an idea from “this could work” to actually making it happen.
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to understand community metrics and use insights to improve strategy.
  • Empathetic, curious, proactive, and genuinely interested in building meaningful communities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Developer Relations (DevRel) or developer advocacy.
  • Experience managing open-source communities or developer-focused programs.
  • Experience building ambassador, campus, referral, or creator programs.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Orbit, HubSpot, or community analytics platforms.
  • Experience creating content for LinkedIn, newsletters, blogs, YouTube, or other social platforms.
  • Existing network across developer, startup, university, or tech communities.
  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or fast-paced environment.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success isn't just about having a large community. It's about building a high-quality, active, and valuable community.

You’ll be successful if you can:

  • Grow the community with the right members, not just more members.
  • Increase meaningful member-to-member engagement.
  • Build events and programs that people actively want to attend.
  • Develop strong partnerships that contribute to community growth.
  • Turn active members into ambassadors and advocates.
  • Use community data and feedback to continuously improve the experience.
  • Build a community that strengthens Masai's presence and credibility in the tech ecosystem.
